evidence: Tin(II) 2,4-pentanedionate (Sn(acac)2) and hydrogen sulﬁde (H2S) were used as the precursors. The viscous ﬂow carrier was ultrahigh pure (UHP) nitrogen gas (99.9999%). The Sn(acac)2 and H2S were dosed by sending N2 gas over the headspace of the precursor in the bubbler. The pressures of the Sn(acac)2 and H2S doses were ∼ 10 and ∼ 150 mTorr, respectively, as measured by a capacitance manometer on the reactor.
